author: val
body: Six open rows is what the tightest glass fits: at 1600x900 the chrome lays out in 800x450, where six rows measured a band at 406..442 and a seventh pushed it to 454, off the glass. A larger group shows six at a time, the window follows the selection, and the group's heading says which six.

author: val
body: The table is bound once and scanned through the binding: every mention of `gpr-entries`, and so every `gpr-at`, rebuilds all seventeen entries, 696 bytes (measured 2026-09-23), and a scan by `gpr-at` cost 19,512 a menu build.
